name: Calypso 1 Seater Motorized Leatherette Recliner with USB Port

description.mood_line: Sink into effortless luxury as the Calypso glides you into a personalized recline.
description.intro: The Calypso 1‑Seater Motorized Leatherette Recliner presents a sleek, low‑profile sofa silhouette.
description.story: Upholstered in supple saddle‑brown leatherette, the seat rests on a heavy‑duty steel frame that promises lasting resilience. Its compact 95 cm × 90 cm footprint and 1.02 m height fit gracefully into modern living rooms, while the quiet electric push‑button mechanism delivers a seamless transition from upright to relaxed. For full recline, allow at least 100 cm of clearance behind the piece, and enjoy the convenience of a built‑in USB charging port.
description.close: With its whisper‑quiet motion and tailored support, the Calypso anchors your space in refined, effortless comfort.

name: Aeroflex 3 Seater Manual Dual-Recliner Fabric Sofa

description.mood_line: Sink into effortless elegance as the Aeroflex cradles you in tailored repose.
description.intro: The Aeroflex 3‑Seater Manual Dual‑Recliner Sofa presents a sleek, low‑profile silhouette anchored by pillow‑top armrests.
description.story: Upholstered in charcoal‑grey textured polyester, the fabric offers a soft, breathable touch while the metal reclining mechanism is concealed within a brushed steel frame. Independent dual‑side latches glide the backrest and footrest into multiple positions, aligning lumbar, back and neck for personalized support, and the smooth extension operates silently. Measuring 2.15 m wide, 95 cm deep and 100 cm high, the piece balances a contemporary footprint with ample clearance for surrounding walls and décor.
description.close: With each quiet recline, the Aeroflex transforms your living room into a sanctuary of restorative comfort.
